title: Denial at the meeting at Swedish military headquarters

tellings.quote: And he just look at me. "No, no, no, no, no. We have not been there." "But you have been filming you. I have filmed you. So, I know you have been there."

plain: A Swedish treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg, whose team found what he calls a UFO on the seafloor, says that at a 2011 meeting at Swedish military headquarters in Stockholm, an officer flatly denied that the military had been to the site. Asberg tells Michels he was in the room: the man said 'No, no, no, no, no. We have not been there,' and Asberg answered that he had filmed them there himself, so he knew they had been.
